structure.unit: Planning, Subdivision of Land and Zoning

law.catch_line: Localities may not require special use permit for certain temporary structures
law.text: A zoning ordinance shall not require that a special exception or special use permit be obtained in order to erect a tent on private property (i) intended to serve as a temporary structure for a period of three days or less and (ii) that will be used primarily for private or family-related events including, but not limited to, weddings and estate sales.
